spans.s:
चय् {c1c} A. (चयते) To go to or
towards, move.

चाय् {c1c} U. (चायति-ते)
1 To observe,
discern, see; तं पार्वतीयप्रमदाश्चचायिरे
[]
विकाशविस्फारितविभ्रमेक्षणाः Śi. 12. 51.
--2 To worship honour.

a lump of clay;
कचानां चयः

a braid of hair;
so चमरीचयः Śi. 4. 60; कुसुमचय,
तुषारचय &c.
--2 A mound of earth
raised to form the foundation of a
building.
--3 A mound of earth
raised from the ditch of a fort.
--4 A rampart.
--5 The gate of
a fort.
--6 A seat, stool.
--7 A
pile of buildings, any edifice.
--8 Stacked wood.
--9 A cover, or
covering.
--10 Arranging or keeping
the sacred fire; cf. अग्निचय.
--11 The
amount by which each term
increases, the common increase or
difference of the terms (in a
progression).

चयनं [चि भावे-ल्युट्]
1 The act of
collecting (especially flowers &c.).
--2 Piling, heaping.
--3 Keeping the
sacred fire.
--4 Stacking wood.
